en.title: Cache Query Handler
en.description:
Cache records give timestamp, key, and value; for each (key,timestamp) query, return the corresponding value.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: n,q≤200000; then n lines of key timestamp value, followed by q lines of key timestamp. Times are HH:MM:SS, and value is an integer. This site adds the guarantee that (key,timestamp) is unique, removing the duplicate-key conflict the original problem left unspecified.
en.output: Output each value in order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
